description: Behaviour-cloned policy, encoding 4 at width 256, from the 114 self-play games in a teacher seat: one forward pass per decision over the previewed candidates, no search. Checkpoint = fold 0 of cycle 118 (35 training games, lr 0.001, batch 256, seed 0, epoch 6 = lowest validation loss; validation accuracy 37.9% on its 11 held-out games), retrained 2026-11-16 with `bc_train.py runs/bc-114-v4-shards --epochs 6 --lr 0.001 --width 256 --val-games 0,2,7,12,17,21,26,30,35,38,43` because a checkpoint is refused when any gaia_rl python source changed since it was saved (python_build_id); the six epochs repeat the 118 figures to the last digit. The checkpoint is under runs/ (not in git) and must exist on the machine that plays.
